info.title: WhatsApp Business API
info.description:
WhatsApp Business API for sending messages, managing templates, and handling media.

## Authentication

Pick **one** of the following on every request:

- **Basic Auth** — enter your username and password.
- **API Key (header)** — pass your API key in the `x-api-key` header.
- **API Key (query param)** — pass your API key as `?apiKey=<your-api-key>` in the URL.

## `x-phone-id` *(in case of multiple phone numbers)*

If your account has more than one WhatsApp number connected, you need to tell the API which one to use. Pass the phone number's ID in either:

- **Header:** `x-phone-id: YOUR_PHONE_ID`, or
- **Query param:** `&phoneId=YOUR_PHONE_ID`

When to send it:
- **One number on your account:** you can skip this — it's picked automatically.
- **Multiple numbers:** **required** — without it, the request will fail.

post.summary: Send bulk messages using CSV campaign
post.description:
Send WhatsApp messages to multiple recipients using CSV file upload. Supports template messages with variables for bulk messaging campaigns.

Add a `schedule` object to the campaign configuration to queue the campaign for later instead of sending it immediately. Scheduled campaigns can be listed with `GET /api/v1/whatsapp/schedule/campaign/list` and cancelled with `DELETE /api/v1/whatsapp/schedule/campaign/{campaignId}`.

scheduledCampaignAfterDelay.description: Sends once, 60 minutes after the campaign is created.

get.description:
List every campaign that still has a pending schedule for this phone number.

Campaigns scheduled through this API send once, so they drop off this list after they have fired. Recurring campaigns stay listed until their schedule is cancelled - these cannot be created through this API, but existing ones appear here with `triggerType` set to `cron`. Campaigns created without a `schedule` never appear here.

200.description: Scheduled campaigns for this phone number. Returns an empty array when nothing is scheduled.

delete.description:
Cancel a campaign's pending schedule so it never sends.

For a recurring campaign this stops all future runs; messages already sent by earlier runs are not affected. This cancels the schedule only - it does not delete the campaign record itself.

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: Id of the scheduled campaign, as returned in the `id` field by `GET /api/v1/whatsapp/schedule/campaign/list` or by the campaign creation response.

CampaignSchedule.description: Optional schedule for a campaign. Omit this field to send immediately. For one-off schedules, set exactly one of `exactDateTime` or `delayInMinutes`; if both are set, `exactDateTime` takes precedence. `cronExpression` is returned for pre-existing recurring campaigns but is not accepted when creating a campaign.

exactDateTime.description: Send once at this instant, given as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds and passed as a string. A timestamp in the past causes the campaign to send immediately.

delayInMinutes.description: Send once after this many minutes have elapsed from the moment the campaign is created. Must be greater than 0.

cronExpression.description: Recurring Quartz expression returned for existing cron-scheduled campaigns; omit it when creating a campaign.

ScheduledCampaign.description: One scheduled Quartz job. The keys below are the usual ones, but the map is free-form.

id.description: Campaign id. Pass this as `campaignId` to cancel the schedule.

name.description: Campaign name given at creation time

campaignType.description: How the campaign's recipients are resolved

phoneNumberId.description: Phone ID the campaign belongs to

exactDateTime.description: Trigger start time for `simple` triggers; null for `cron` triggers. Epoch milliseconds.

cronExpression.description: Cron expression for `cron` triggers; null for `simple` triggers.

fileUploadId.description: Id of the uploaded CSV backing a `CSV` campaign. Omitted for other campaign types.

contactFilterId.description: Id of the contact filter backing a `CONTACT_FILTER` campaign. Omitted for other campaign types.

lastUpdateTime.description: When the schedule was created or last updated, as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

jobNameSuffix.description: Internal scheduler discriminator. Always `_campaign` for campaign schedules.

body.description: Base64 encoded file content (without data URI prefix)

messaging_product.description: Messaging product identifier. Defaults to whatsapp.

file.description: Binary file to upload to WhatsApp media storage

name.description: Template name (lowercase, no spaces, underscores allowed)

SendMessageResponse.description: Null fields are omitted. `error` is returned with HTTP 200 only when the send is blocked before it reaches Meta - insufficient wallet balance, or an opted-out receiver. A rejection by Meta returns HTTP 400 instead.

id.description: Id of the stored message record. Use it to correlate the send with delivery-status webhooks and message reports.

userMessageId.description: Caller-supplied correlation id, echoed back only when it was set on the request.

waMessageId.description: WhatsApp message id assigned by Meta. Absent when the message was not accepted.

MetaError.description: Why the send was blocked. `code` is 0 for the checks this platform makes before calling Meta.

message.example: Not enough balance to send the message.

details.example: Please recharge your wallet and try again.

active.description: Accepted by the current request model, but the backend decides the final active state.

teamId.description: Required when target is TEAM. Optional for USER with assignTeam=true or ROUND_ROBIN to use a specific team.

assignTeam.description: When target is USER, also assign the related team if true

PaginatedReportResponse.description: Paginated sent-message report. `results` is omitted when nothing matched.

total.description: Total records matching the query across all pages.

MessageReport.description: One sent-message report row. Null fields are omitted.

id.description: Id of the stored message record.

userMessageId.description: Caller-supplied correlation id, present only if one was sent.

message.description: The outbound message payload as sent to Meta.

timestamp.description: Meta status timestamp, epoch seconds as a string.

statusTime.description: Epoch-second timestamps (as strings) per status; only the statuses reached are present.

PaymentConfiguration.description: Active payment configuration profile returned by /api/v1/whatsapp/metaPayment/configs/active

ContactListResponse.description: Paginated contact list. `results` is omitted when nothing matched.

total.description: Total records matching the query across all pages.

receiverNumber.description: Recipient phone number in international format

labels.description: List of label IDs to assign to the contact

file.description: CSV file to import contacts. Required column: receiverNumber. Additional columns matching existing contact attribute names are imported as attributes.

SuccessResponse.description: Generic acknowledgement. `message` is endpoint-specific - see each operation's example for the exact wording it returns.

ProblemDetail.description: Error body, sent as application/problem+json. `timestamp` is present only on some errors.

timestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds. Present only on errors built through ProblemDetailUtil.

template.description: The stored Meta template definition (name, language, category, status, components).

ContactRecord.description: A stored contact. Distinct from `Contact`, which is the Meta contact-message payload.

BulkOperationResponse.description: SYNC returns affectedCount and durationMs; ASYNC returns operationId instead.

message.description: The message payload sent to each recipient.

MetaSendMessageProblem.description: Returned when Meta rejects a send. `error` carries Meta's own error object, with its snake_case keys unchanged.

status.description: Meta's own HTTP status, passed through.

instance.description: Request path. Omitted when not set.

error.description: Meta's error object, verbatim - snake_case keys are preserved.

details.example: The phone number is malformed: Please use the format: +1234567890.

timestamp.description: Added by ProblemDetailUtil on every error. Epoch milliseconds.

UnauthorizedProblem.description: 401 body. Unlike other errors, custom properties stay nested under `properties`, and `type` is null.

type.description: Literal null on this path - the custom serializer that would default it to "about:blank" is not registered on this mapper.

detail.example: An Authentication object was not found in the SecurityContext

instance.description: Request path, always set on this path.

properties.description: Custom properties, nested on this path only.
